successors.text: Surguja, 'a vast mountainous area' in present-day Chhattisgarh, 15,770 km2 in 1901; outline is the plain geography of the Surguja region, the page gives no boundary

ledger.x: 1613: Surguja State is founded; the page gives no founder or event.
1 January 1948: the last Maharaja signed accession to the Indian Union.
1948: the princely state ends on accession to India.

certainty.note: No boundaries on the page; outline is a regional polygon.
